home.title: Axel Martínez
home.description: Mexican software artisan. Eternal apprentice of web technologies. Insatiable learner. Father. Beatle fan.
home.intro: Hello there! I'm a Mexican software engineer whose career has been mostly dedicated to the frontend and JS/TS stacks. I've built on the web for more than {years} years (wow, time flies!) and I'm really excited to share with you through this website my professional experience as well as things I create apart from my day job. Please feel free to poke around and reach out as well. Have a good one!

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Side projects, custom tools and experiments I work on
projects.intro: Side projects, tools and experiments that I've built mostly for myself. Most of them are my attempts to learn new things: techniques, tools, technologies, and things like that. There's a pattern with the names you will see. For a while now I have been giving them names in Nahuatl, an ancient language spoken in Mexico since before colonial times.

media.title: Content
media.description: I don't want to be an influencer, just share stuff with you all
media.intro: I started a YT playlist in 2017 with videos about building a desktop application. Ever since, I've been really interested in learning about software, hardware and techniques for creating videos and also the audio gear and stuff like that. So here's the result of all these years of me trying to create content so far. The idea isn't to become a tech influencer or anything like that; I'm just trying to share stuff with people.
